summary.text: Matt Frumin is the Ward 3 member of the Council of the District of Columbia.

paragraphs.text: Frumin served on Advisory Neighborhood Commission 3E for six and a half years, half of them as chair, and sat on the board of Tenleytown Main Street for six years.
He has worked as an attorney for over 30 years and was a political appointee at the U.S. Department of State during the Clinton administration.
He and his wife live in AU Park.
